verdict.rationale: Dunning is a fair question for a billing platform, but the evidence pack never mentions dunning sequences, branded recovery emails, in-app banners, grace periods, or cancel-versus-unpaid final-state rules. Metronome hands invoices to Stripe for payment collection, but any recovery logic there would belong to Stripe, not Metronome. Webhooks and credit-gating are adjacent features and do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can configure automated dunning sequences — branded emails, in-app banners, grace periods, and final-state rules like cancel vs unpaid
